name: Vampire
summary: Fast, lethal and always thirsty. Vampires burn in the sun and must feed to stay on their feet.
daylight: Burns. Sunlight sets a vampire alight, and so do holy places: vampires cannot enter church interiors.
blood: A thirst meter. Feed on players, villagers or blood bags to refill it and earn XP. Without blood a vampire desiccates.

abilities.name: Blood Sucking
abilities.effect: Bite and drink, restoring some Blood while dealing a little damage. A bitten vampire cannot regenerate while it lasts.

abilities.name: Vampiric Vision
abilities.effect: See the organs inside other beings and sense creatures from far away.

abilities.name: Neck Break
abilities.effect: Instantly break the neck of an NPC or player.

abilities.name: Hypnosis
abilities.effect: Hypnotise and control players and NPCs.

abilities.name: Ceiling Sleep
abilities.effect: Hang from the ceiling and sleep for slow, AFK XP. XP boosts do not affect it.

abilities.name: Infect
abilities.effect: Begin turning a Human. See *Ways in*.

abilities.name: Heart Extraction
abilities.effect: Rip out a [[heart]]. Eating it grants one extra life against a lethal attack.

abilities.name: Bloodline
abilities.effect: Found a Bloodline and bind Humans to it. Members turn into vampires tied to you; you can watch and command them and take 50% of the XP they earn. A member goes free at Level 300.

abilities.name: Chest Swarm
abilities.effect: A swarm strikes the target and drags it before flying back. Damage scales with level. Added 26 October 2026.

abilities.name: Ground Stomp
abilities.effect: Hold the punch button to crack the ground with a shockwave. Once an Original's move.

clan.name: Bloodline
clan.body:
Vampires gather in bloodlines, as witches form covens and werewolves form packs.

- `/bloodline <name>` and `/editbloodline <name>`
- `/delbloodline`
- `/blinvite <player>`, `/blaccept`, `/bldecline`
- `/blkick <player>`, `/blleave`, `/blmembers`

sections.heading: Natural-born
sections.body: A Natural-Born Vampire is not a spawn choice. It comes with the [[original-vampire-pass]], and starts with supernatural speed and abilities.

sections.heading: Sun protection
sections.body:
- Stay indoors, or in the castle
- [[temporary-sun-ring]], crafted by a witch
- [[sun-ring-pass]]
- [[vampire-hat]]
- [[vampire-cape]]

sections.heading: Minions
sections.body:
Any vampire of Lv 3,000 or higher can keep a minion:

1. Reach Lv 3,000.
2. Infect a normal Human.
3. They say *“I'm your servant and I wait for your orders.”* They are now your minion.
4. Walk up to them and press **L** to command them.

Minions can help you farm and add damage. More abilities, such as shopping and mining, may come later.

disputed: Vampire ranks: one guide lists the ladder above; another says vampires have no named ranks.

An older source lists different keybinds (Q Snap Neck, E Bite, R Rip Heart, G Feed Blood, Y Decapitate, C Compulsion, H Super Hearing, X Carry, V Vampire Face, B Sleep). They have not been reconciled with the level system.
